name: Jev Agent Skills
summary: Portable typed decision helpers for agent intent, completion evidence, progress and eligible candidate selection, with bounded Camofox browsing and shadow context relevance.

reading.subtitle: Small Jev decisions for agent checks and bounded browser flows.
reading.why: Agents can use a small structured judgment when a plan, evidence match or next browser action is ambiguous, while keeping execution and authority in their existing harness.

highlights.title: Install the skill
highlights.summary: One reviewed copy for Codex, Claude or a shared skills directory, using your own OpenRouter key.

highlights.title: Agent checks and context
highlights.summary: Request and evidence packets for advisory checks; shadow relevance preserves all original context.

highlights.title: Camofox browser loops
highlights.summary: Caller-permitted controls, observed targets, step limits and URL/text readback; requires an existing Camofox service.

relationships.context: Skills Hub discovers and installs the pinned jev-judgment snapshot; the standalone repository owns this pack and its releases.
